user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Used to surface search results in ChatGPT features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads; not used for model training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to make foundation models more useful and safe.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests and interactions with external applications via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for generative AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to exclude future materials from AI model training datasets.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to user-directed queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Web content retrieved directly during user-initiated requests and questions.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent retrieving content for user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance user search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent indexing content for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes, perform product specific crawls, and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video-related content for Google Search and products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: Google News, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl product information for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling and fetching for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites; internal R&D.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl requested by site owners to build Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents; requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes internet data automatically for search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes internet information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers Apple search technology and trains foundation models for generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled website data for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; controls data usage for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content associated with Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to display metadata and preview information.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared across Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance and cite sources in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content relevant to advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and indexes content directly to improve products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for foundation AI model training and direct product indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links fetched on user request to help AI complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: Fetches are user-requested and may bypass robots.txt rules.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services, and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to provide accurate information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and page-level noarchive or noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for search eligibility; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and page-level noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions and fetch live information on the user's behalf.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information from the web for user-initiated queries such as Alexa questions.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open crawl datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset and sample of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Set User-agent: CCBot with Disallow: / in robots.txt or use the opt-out registry.
